decision_rules.protocol: dc_v1 unchanged; walk-forward refit per match date, 3-year lookback; xi tuned on E1 validation (2015/16-2017/18) by RPS on the E0 grid, a grid-edge optimum reported as a limitation, grid not extended; test = 2018/19 to 2026-09-20 (the published E0 window) in both leagues; matches without the odds a comparison needs are excluded from it and counted; 95% CIs from a date-block bootstrap (5,000 resamples); 98.3% (Bonferroni, 3 primary questions) reported as robustness only.
decision_rules.Q1: RPS gap = model - devigged close, per match. E1 gap smaller than E0 gap if the 95% CI of (gap E1 - gap E0), resampling match dates jointly across both leagues, lies entirely below 0. Independent per-league bootstrap: sensitivity only.
decision_rules.Q2: For each match the model bets on (edge > 0 at open odds, backtest rule): CLV of the bet minus the expected CLV of a uniformly random bet on the same match. E1 market softer if the 95% CI of the mean lies entirely above 0.
decision_rules.Q3: p = w*model + (1-w)*devigged open, w on a 0..1 grid (step 0.05) chosen by E1 validation RPS. Model adds information the E1 market lacks if w > 0 and the 95% CI of test RPS (blend - open) lies entirely below 0.
